candidates.title: Calculate shipping rates by rewards tier

demandEvidence.chore: Calculate the proper shipping price for customers based on their rewards-program tier.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Bronze is 7%, silver is 4%, and gold is 0% I would love to be able to get everyone the proper pricing for their shipping but need a little help and guidance.

ease.reason: A beginner can test a rate table from merchant-entered tiers and sample orders; the post supplies tiers but no implementation reference.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: small online shops may value correct tier-based shipping; this request does not establish an AI service buyer or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can calculate a suggested rate from supplied tier and shipping inputs, then compare hand-checked examples; store integration is unverified.

autonomy.reason: A repeatable calculator can produce a rate suggestion, but a shop operator must verify rules and approve any live shipping configuration.

evidence.reason: The discussion gives three tier percentages and asks for correct shipping prices, but omits carrier rules, order examples and repeat frequency.

candidates.reason: Experiment: use operator-entered tier percentages and sample shipping amounts; a manual test run calculates suggested rates, which are compared with hand-checked examples before any operator-approved live change. No implementation reference, carrier constraints or paying customer is established.
